blocker: The supplied section covers inverse-function definitions, base-graph properties, evaluation, finding inverses by swapping x and y, and adding ordinates. It does not supply teaching or exercises asking students to transform inverse-trigonometric graphs, determine transformed domains, ranges, intercepts or asymptotes, or recover transformation parameters. Supply the source heading and complete exercise set for transformations of inverse trigonometric functions, including any associated figures, to establish booklet question types for this skill.
